qa_pair.question: Counting every level of the bill of materials, and ignoring revisions that are still under an open change notice, how many M4 titanium fasteners does one complete ESPA-class smallsat bus consume? Answer with a whole number.
How many photovoltaic cells go into one complete smallsat bus, counting every sub-assembly? Answer with a whole number.
Among the purchased components of the propulsion module, which one takes the longest to replenish? Answer with the item's name exactly as Carbon shows it.
One valve in the propulsion module is being phased out in favour of a successor part. What is the successor's replenishment lead time in days? Answer with a whole number.

At the prices quoted by their supplier, what do the reaction wheels and star trackers needed for one attitude determination and control system cost in total, in USD? Answer with a whole number and no currency symbol or separators.
Our defense customer orders the complete smallsat bus under their own part number. What is that part number, without the revision? Answer with the part number only.
A customer-reported quality problem has already been closed. What disposition was recorded for the item involved? Answer with the disposition exactly as Carbon shows it.
For the most severe non-conformance that is still open, what disposition was recorded for the purchased part involved? Answer with the disposition exactly as Carbon shows it.
One engineering change to a sub-assembly of the smallsat bus is currently being implemented. Which item does it affect? Answer with the item's name exactly as Carbon shows it.
Which work center has a monthly preventive maintenance schedule and also a maintenance dispatch that needs the equipment maker's help at the highest priority? Answer with the work center's name.
